Project Control Tower {{VERSION}} — how to install
====================================================

This ZIP holds the Windows installer, {{EXE}}.
It isn't code-signed yet (see the code signing policy below), so Windows
SmartScreen doesn't recognise it. Two ways to install it:

A) Check it, then unblock it (no warning)
   1. Check the installer is the original. In PowerShell, in this folder:
        (Get-FileHash ".\{{EXE}}").Hash
      must print:
        {{SHA256}}
      (the same value is listed on the release page).
   2. Right-click the installer -> Properties -> tick "Unblock" -> OK.
      Only do this for an installer that passed step 1.
   3. Run the installer.

B) Or just run it
   Run the installer, and at "Windows protected your PC" click
   "More info" -> "Run anyway".

In the installer, choose "Only for me": it installs for your user only and
needs no administrator rights. Installing over an earlier version keeps
your data.

The app works fully offline and sends nothing anywhere.
To uninstall: Windows Settings -> Apps -> Installed apps -> Project Control
Tower. Your data stays in %APPDATA%\Project Control Tower until you delete
that folder.

Release page: https://github.com/CosminBMemetea/project-control-tower/releases
Code signing policy: https://github.com/CosminBMemetea/project-control-tower/blob/main/CODE_SIGNING.md
